fields.label: Test mode
fields.description: Nothing is sent outside this server. Only local simulator addresses are allowed.

fields.label: Enable AI features
fields.description: Show AI skills, summaries, translation and AI replies in Relay.

fields.label: Enable chat folders
fields.description: Show personal chat folders in the Relay inbox.

fields.label: Enable teams
fields.description: Show team management, team assignment and team labels in Relay. Team membership still controls who sees a chat.

fields.label: Enable flows
fields.description: Show the flow builder and run published flows on incoming WhatsApp messages.

fields.label: AI handoff owner
fields.description: Fallback for skill handoffs; must have access to the conversation.

fields.label: Voice transcription provider
fields.description: Transcribes received voice notes in the background. Requires an enabled OpenAI provider with a transcription model.

fields.label: AI memory model
fields.description: Summarizes each record's conversations every night into day, week, month and year memory for the AI. Empty turns the memory job off.

fields.label: Event memory model
fields.description: Builds the memory of each Relay AI Event from its description, files and links. Choose a model with vision support to read images. Empty uses the AI memory model.

fields.label: Max AI file size (MB)
fields.description: The AI skips larger event attachments and pages.

fields.label: Send WhatsApp read receipts
fields.description: When an operator reads a one-to-one WhatsApp chat, the customer sees blue ticks on the newest message.

fields.label: Show WhatsApp typing indicator
fields.description: While an operator types a reply, the customer sees a typing indicator. WhatsApp also marks their newest message as read.

fields.label: WhatsApp margin percent
fields.description: Added on top of Meta's WhatsApp charges on the Billing page. Only a System Manager can change it.

fields.label: Opt-out keywords
fields.description: One per line. An incoming message that is exactly one of these words, in any case, opts the number out of campaigns and gets no automatic reply.

fields.label: Opt-in keywords
fields.description: One per line. An incoming message that is exactly one of these words opts the number back in.
